scope: ILLUSTRATIVE, SYNTHETIC: an invented e+e- collider detector at fixed sqrt(s) used to show that a non-AMS experiment plugs in through profile resources only. Event generator, efficiency, resolution and luminosity are invented and describe no real experiment.
exclusions: Any real experiment's detector, data, performance numbers or practice
Physics claims: the generated angular shape and cross section are synthetic inputs, not predictions
maintainer: hchouTW (illustrative profile; not a real experiment)

capabilities.name: synthetic-event-generation
capabilities.scope: Seeded synthetic e+e- -> mu+mu- angular events (cos theta) with a configurable 1 + a cos^2 + b cos shape; no theory code imported

capabilities.name: synthetic-detector-model
capabilities.scope: Invented efficiency and Gaussian cos theta smearing with an analytic response matrix that includes the efficiency

capabilities.name: corrected-angular-distribution
capabilities.scope: Path B (examples/collider-angular): luminosity-normalized, efficiency- and resolution-corrected d sigma / d cos theta and fiducial cross section with covariance; Asimov and seeded-toy closure against independent analytic expected values. Synthetic and illustrative only

capabilities.name: resolution-and-efficiency-study
capabilities.scope: J2 (examples/detector-resolution): per-bin cos theta resolution and efficiency at detector level with a constant-width fit and replicate pulls. Synthetic and illustrative only
